title: Bug: Application crashes on startup
body: When I start the application, it immediately crashes with error code 500. This happens every time I try to launch it.

title: Feature Request: Add dark mode
body: It would be great to have a dark mode option for the application. Many users prefer dark themes.

title: Documentation: API endpoints not documented
body: The API documentation is missing information about the authentication endpoints. Please add documentation for /api/auth/*

title: Question: How to configure database connection?
body: I'm trying to set up the application but I'm not sure how to configure the database connection. Can someone help?

title: Bug: App crashes when clicking submit button
body: Similar to issue #1, the application crashes but this time when I click the submit button on the form.
